 101 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 102  * Function:    H5O__pline_decode
 103  *
 104  * Purpose:     Decodes a filter pipeline message.
 105  *
 106  * Return:      Success:    Ptr to the native message.
 107  *              Failure:    NULL
 108  *
 109  * Programmer:  Robb Matzke
 110  *              Wednesday, April 15, 1998
 111  *
 112  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 113  */
 114 
 115 static void *
 116 H5O__pline_decode(H5F_t H5_ATTR_UNUSED *f, H5O_t H5_ATTR_UNUSED *open_oh, unsigned H5_ATTR_UNUSED mesg_flags,
 117                   unsigned H5_ATTR_UNUSED *ioflags, size_t p_size, const uint8_t *p)
 118 {
 119     H5O_pline_t       *pline = NULL;               /* Pipeline message */
 120     H5Z_filter_info_t *filter;                     /* Filter to decode */
 121     size_t             name_length;                /* Length of filter name */
 122     size_t             i;                          /* Local index variable */
 123     const uint8_t     *p_end     = p + p_size - 1; /* End of the p buffer */
 124     void              *ret_value = NULL;           /* Return value */
 125 
 126     FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
 127 
 128     /* check args */
 129     HDassert(p);
 130 
 131     /* Allocate space for I/O pipeline message */
 132     if (NULL == (pline = H5FL_CALLOC(H5O_pline_t)))
 133         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
 134 
 135     /* Version */
 136     if (p + 4 - 1 > p_end) /* 4 byte is minimum for all versions */
 137         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "ran off the end of the buffer: current p = %p, p_end = %p",
 138                     (const void *)(p + 4), (const void *)p_end)
 139     pline->version = *p++;
 140     if (pline->version < H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1 || pline->version > H5O_PLINE_VERSION_LATEST)
 141         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "bad version number for filter pipeline message")
 142 
 143     /* Number of filters */
 144     pline->nused = *p++;
 145     if (pline->nused > H5Z_MAX_NFILTERS) {
 146 
 147         /* Reset the number of filters used to avoid array traversal in error
 148          * handling code.
 149          */
 150         pline->nused = 0;
 151 
 152         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "filter pipeline message has too many filters")
 153     }
 154 
 155     /* Reserved */
 156     if (pline->version == H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1)
 157         p += 6;
 158 
 159     /* Allocate array for filters */
 160     pline->nalloc = pline->nused;
 161     if (NULL == (pline->filter = (H5Z_filter_info_t *)H5MM_calloc(pline->nalloc * sizeof(pline->filter[0]))))
 162         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
 163 
 164     /* Decode filters */
 165     for (i = 0, filter = &pline->filter[0]; i < pline->nused; i++, filter++) {
 166         /* Filter ID */
 167         if (p + 6 - 1 > p_end) /* 6 bytes minimum */
 168             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL,
 169                         "ran off the end of the buffer: current p = %p, p_end = %p", (const void *)(p + 6),
 170                         (const void *)p_end)
 171         UINT16DECODE(p, filter->id);
 172 
 173         /* Length of filter name */
 174         if (pline->version > H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1 && filter->id < H5Z_FILTER_RESERVED)
 175             name_length = 0;
 176         else {
 177             UINT16DECODE(p, name_length);
 178             if (pline->version == H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1 && name_length % 8)
 179                 HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "filter name length is not a multiple of eight")
 180             if (p + 4 - 1 > p_end) /* with name_length 4 bytes to go */
 181                 HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL,
 182                             "ran off the end of the buffer: current p = %p, p_end = %p",
 183                             (const void *)(p + 4), (const void *)p_end)
 184         } /* end if */
 185 
 186         /* Filter flags */
 187         UINT16DECODE(p, filter->flags);
 188 
 189         /* Number of filter parameters ("client data elements") */
 190         UINT16DECODE(p, filter->cd_nelmts);
 191 
 192         /* Filter name, if there is one */
 193         if (name_length) {
 194             size_t actual_name_length; /* Actual length of name */
 195             size_t len = (size_t)(p_end - p + 1);
 196             /* Determine actual name length (without padding, but with null terminator) */
 197             actual_name_length = HDstrnlen((const char *)p, len);
 198             if (actual_name_length == len)
 199                 HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "filter name not null terminated")
 200             actual_name_length += 1; /* include \0 byte */
 201             HDassert(actual_name_length <= name_length);
 202 
 203             /* Allocate space for the filter name, or use the internal buffer */
 204             if (actual_name_length > H5Z_COMMON_NAME_LEN) {
 205                 filter->name = (char *)H5MM_malloc(actual_name_length);
 206                 if (NULL == filter->name)
 207                     HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed for filter name")
 208             } /* end if */
 209             else
 210                 filter->name = filter->_name;
 211 
 212             HDstrncpy(filter->name, (const char *)p, actual_name_length);
 213             p += name_length;
 214         } /* end if */
 215 
 216         /* Filter parameters */
 217         if (filter->cd_nelmts) {
 218             size_t j; /* Local index variable */
 219 
 220             /* Allocate space for the client data elements, or use the internal buffer */
 221             if (filter->cd_nelmts > H5Z_COMMON_CD_VALUES) {
 222                 filter->cd_values = (unsigned *)H5MM_malloc(filter->cd_nelmts * sizeof(unsigned));
 223                 if (NULL == filter->cd_values)
 224                     HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed for client data")
 225             } /* end if */
 226             else
 227                 filter->cd_values = filter->_cd_values;
 228 
 229             /*
 230              * Read the client data values and the padding
 231              */
 232             for (j = 0; j < filter->cd_nelmts; j++) {
 233                 if (p + 4 - 1 <= p_end)
 234                     UINT32DECODE(p, filter->cd_values[j])

 272 H5O__pline_encode(H5F_t H5_ATTR_UNUSED *f, uint8_t *p /*out*/, const void *mesg)
 273 {
 274     const H5O_pline_t       *pline = (const H5O_pline_t *)mesg; /* Pipeline message to encode */
 275     const H5Z_filter_info_t *filter;                            /* Filter to encode */

 277

 282     HDassert(mesg);

 286     *p++ = (uint8_t)(pline->nused);
 287     if (pline->version == H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1) {
 288         *p++ = 0; /*reserved 1*/
 289         *p++ = 0; /*reserved 2*/
 290         *p++ = 0; /*reserved 3*/
 291         *p++ = 0; /*reserved 4*/
 292         *p++ = 0; /*reserved 5*/
 293         *p++ = 0; /*reserved 6*/
 294     }             /* end if */
 295 
 296     /* Encode filters */
 297     for (i = 0, filter = &pline->filter[0]; i < pline->nused; i++, filter++) {
 298         const char *name;        /* Filter name */
 299         size_t      name_length; /* Length of filter name */
 300 
 301         /* Filter ID */
 302         UINT16ENCODE(p, filter->id);
 303 
 304         /* Skip writing the name length & name if the filter is an internal filter */
 305         if (pline->version > H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1 && filter->id < H5Z_FILTER_RESERVED) {

 308         } /* end if */

 311

 315              * as it was registered.
 316              */

 318                 name = cls->name;
 319             name_length = name ? HDstrlen(name) + 1 : 0;
 320 
 321             /* Filter name length */
 322             UINT16ENCODE(p, pline->version == H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1 ? H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_length) : name_length);
 323         } /* end else */
 324 
 325         /* Filter flags */
 326         UINT16ENCODE(p, filter->flags);
 327 
 328         /* # of filter parameters */
 329         UINT16ENCODE(p, filter->cd_nelmts);
 330 
 331         /* Encode name, if there is one to encode */
 332         if (name_length > 0) {
 333             /* Store name, with null terminator */
 334             H5MM_memcpy(p, name, name_length);
 335             p += name_length;
 336 
 337             /* Pad out name to alignment, in older versions */
 338             if (pline->version == H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1)
 339                 while (name_length++ % 8)

 341         } /* end if */
 342 
 343         /* Filter parameters */

 346 
 347         /* Align the parameters for older versions of the format */
 348         if (pline->version == H5O_PLINE_VERSION_1)
 349             if (filter->cd_nelmts % 2)
 350                 UINT32ENCODE(p, 0);
 351     } /* end for */
 352 
 353     FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(SUCCEED)
 354 } /* end H5O__pline_encode() */

 341  *
 342  * Purpose:	Insert a link into the  dense link storage structures for a group
 343  *
 344  * Return:	Non-negative on success/Negative on failure

 351 herr_t
 352 H5G__dense_insert(H5F_t *f, const H5O_linfo_t *linfo, const H5O_link_t *lnk)
 353 {
 354     H5G_bt2_ud_ins_t udata;                       /* User data for v2 B-tree insertion */
 355     H5HF_t          *fheap      = NULL;           /* Fractal heap handle */
 356     H5B2_t          *bt2_name   = NULL;           /* v2 B-tree handle for name index */
 357     H5B2_t          *bt2_corder = NULL;           /* v2 B-tree handle for creation order index */
 358     size_t           link_size;                   /* Size of serialized link in the heap */
 359     H5WB_t          *wb = NULL;                   /* Wrapped buffer for link data */
 360     uint8_t          link_buf[H5G_LINK_BUF_SIZE]; /* Buffer for serializing link */
 361     void            *link_ptr  = NULL;            /* Pointer to serialized link */
 362     herr_t           ret_value = SUCCEED;         /* Return value */
 363 
 364     FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
 365 
 366     /*
 367      * Check arguments.
 368      */
 369     HDassert(f);
 370     HDassert(linfo);
 371     HDassert(lnk);
 372 
 373     /* Find out the size of buffer needed for serialized link */
 374     if ((link_size = H5O_msg_raw_size(f, H5O_LINK_ID, FALSE, lnk)) == 0)
 375         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTGETSIZE, FAIL, "can't get link size")
 376 
 377     /* Wrap the local buffer for serialized link */
 378     if (NULL == (wb = H5WB_wrap(link_buf, sizeof(link_buf))))
 379         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTINIT, FAIL, "can't wrap buffer")
 380 
 381     /* Get a pointer to a buffer that's large enough for link */
 382     if (NULL == (link_ptr = H5WB_actual(wb, link_size)))
 383         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_NOSPACE, FAIL, "can't get actual buffer")
 384 
 385     /* Create serialized form of link */
 386     if (H5O_msg_encode(f, H5O_LINK_ID, FALSE, (unsigned char *)link_ptr, lnk) < 0)
 387         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode link")
 388 
 389     /* Open the fractal heap */
 390     if (NULL == (fheap = H5HF_open(f, linfo->fheap_addr)))
 391         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTOPENOBJ, FAIL, "unable to open fractal heap")
 392 
 393     /* Insert the serialized link into the fractal heap */
 394     if (H5HF_insert(fheap, link_size, link_ptr, udata.id) < 0)
 395         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTINSERT, FAIL, "unable to insert link into fractal heap")
 396 
 397     /* Open the name index v2 B-tree */
 398     if (NULL == (bt2_name = H5B2_open(f, linfo->name_bt2_addr, NULL)))
 399         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTOPENOBJ, FAIL, "unable to open v2 B-tree for name index")
 400 
 401     /* Create the callback information for v2 B-tree record insertion */
 402     udata.common.f             = f;
 403     udata.common.fheap         = fheap;
 404     udata.common.name          = lnk->name;
 405     udata.common.name_hash     = H5_checksum_lookup3(lnk->name, HDstrlen(lnk->name), 0);
 406     udata.common.corder        = lnk->corder;
 407     udata.common.found_op      = NULL;
 408     udata.common.found_op_data = NULL;
 409     /* udata.id already set in H5HF_insert() call */
 410

 412     if (H5B2_insert(bt2_name, &udata) < 0)

 414
